brief:
UN Secretary-General António Guterres said Thursday that the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine refugees operates under "extraordinary pressure," according to UN News. He warned that UNRWA's work and mandate face jeopardy as the agency struggles with mounting constraints.

The agency provides humanitarian assistance and services to Palestinian refugees across the region and continues to confront significant operational challenges.
dek: The UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine refugees (UNRWA) continues to operate under “extraordinary pressure”, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said on Thursday.
title: Guterres warns UNRWA's work and mandate face jeopardy
